stanley_park.name: Stanley Park
stanley_park.hours: Open 24 hours · park drive one-way for cars
stanley_park.tip: Rent a bike near the entrance and ride the 9 km Seawall loop; allow two hours.

granville_island.name: Granville Island
granville_island.price_text: Free to enter · pay per item at the market
granville_island.hours: Public Market roughly 09:00–18:00 · check on the day
granville_island.tip: Come hungry for the Public Market, then walk the waterfront for harbour views.

canada_place.name: Canada Place
canada_place.price_text: Free to walk the promenade · FlyOver Canada ticketed separately
canada_place.hours: Promenade open daily · check on the day
canada_place.tip: Walk the pier for views of the North Shore mountains and cruise ships.

capilano_bridge.name: Capilano Suspension Bridge
capilano_bridge.price_text: Adult ticket roughly CAD 60–75 · check on the day
capilano_bridge.hours: Daily, usually 09:00–17:00 or later in summer · check on the day
capilano_bridge.tip: Go early to beat tour buses; the Cliffwalk and Treetops add an hour.

gastown_steam_clock.name: Gastown Steam Clock
gastown_steam_clock.hours: Always visible · whistles on the quarter hour
gastown_steam_clock.tip: Arrive a few minutes before the quarter hour to hear it whistle.
gastown_steam_clock.best: Any time; evening for the lit streets

vancouver_aquarium.name: Vancouver Aquarium
vancouver_aquarium.price_text: Adult ticket roughly CAD 45–60 · check on the day
vancouver_aquarium.hours: Daily, usually 10:00–17:00 · check on the day
vancouver_aquarium.tip: Book online and go at opening; the otter and jellyfish galleries are the highlights.

moa_ubc.name: Museum of Anthropology at UBC
moa_ubc.price_text: Adult ticket roughly CAD 18–25 · check on the day
moa_ubc.hours: Closed Mondays in some seasons · usually 10:00–17:00 · check on the day
moa_ubc.tip: The Great Hall totem poles are the reason to come; allow two hours.

cypress_mountain.name: Cypress Mountain
cypress_mountain.price_text: Ski pass and rentals vary by season · check on the day
cypress_mountain.tip: In summer hike the trails for city views; in winter book ski passes ahead.
cypress_mountain.best: Winter for skiing; summer for hikes

false_creek_ferry.name: False Creek Ferry
false_creek_ferry.price_text: Small hop fare roughly CAD 4–6 · check on the day
false_creek_ferry.hours: Daytime service · check on the day
false_creek_ferry.tip: Use the little rainbow ferries as cheap transport between Granville Island and downtown.

fraser_river.name: Fraser River
fraser_river.tip: Walk the riverside paths near Steveston for fishing boats and fish and chips.

papa_murphys.name: Papa Murphy's
papa_murphys.price_text: Take-and-bake pizza roughly CAD 12–25 · check on the day
papa_murphys.hours: Varies by branch · check on the day
papa_murphys.tip: It is take-and-bake: you cook the pizza yourself, so it suits an apartment stay.
papa_murphys.best: Evening, for an easy meal in

playland.name: Playland, Vancouver
playland.price_text: Ride pass roughly CAD 40–55 · check on the day
playland.hours: Seasonal, mainly summer · check on the day
playland.tip: The wooden roller coaster is the classic ride; check opening days before you go.

science_world.name: Science World
science_world.price_text: Adult ticket roughly CAD 25–35 · check on the day
science_world.hours: Daily, usually 10:00–17:00 · check on the day
science_world.tip: Good for families and rainy days; the dome is a False Creek landmark.

ubc.name: University of British Columbia (UBC)
ubc.price_text: Free to walk the campus · museums ticketed
ubc.tip: Pair a campus walk with the Museum of Anthropology and the nearby beaches.

granville_market_food.name: Granville Island Public Market
granville_market_food.price_text: Pay per item · snacks roughly CAD 5–15
granville_market_food.tip: Buy picnic supplies here before a Seawall walk.

queen_elizabeth_viewpoint.name: Queen Elizabeth Park viewpoint
queen_elizabeth_viewpoint.hours: Park open daily, usually dawn to dusk
queen_elizabeth_viewpoint.tip: Highest point in the city; come for skyline and mountain views.

seawall_bike_tour.name: Seawall bike ride
seawall_bike_tour.price_text: Bike rental roughly CAD 15–30 per hour · check on the day
seawall_bike_tour.hours: Rentals daytime · check on the day
seawall_bike_tour.tip: Ride from English Bay to Stanley Park and back for an easy flat route.

gastown_walk.name: Gastown neighbourhood walk
gastown_walk.tip: Walk Water Street for brick buildings and the steam clock, then grab coffee.

english_bay_beach.name: English Bay Beach
english_bay_beach.tip: Sunset here is the classic Vancouver evening; bring a layer, it cools fast.

chinatown_walk.name: Chinatown food walk
chinatown_walk.price_text: Pay per item · snacks roughly CAD 5–20
chinatown_walk.hours: Daytime, most shops 10:00–18:00 · check on the day
chinatown_walk.tip: Try dim sum and the Chinese garden; go with an appetite.

grouse_mountain.name: Grouse Mountain gondola
grouse_mountain.price_text: Gondola ticket roughly CAD 60–80 · check on the day
grouse_mountain.hours: Daily, hours vary by season · check on the day
grouse_mountain.tip: Clear days give the best city views; check the webcam before going up.
